hooks.prompt: A .csproj file in src/ was just written or edited. Reconcile README.md with the actual library projects: (1) Extract PackageId from every .csproj under src/ that has one. (2) Compare against all package entries in the README.md tables. (3) Add any missing packages to the correct section using the badge format `![Version](https://img.shields.io/nuget/vpre/{PackageId}?label=)`. (4) Remove rows for packages that no longer exist. (5) Section placement rules: EventSourcing.* → Data & Persistence; Storage.* → Data & Persistence; KeyVault.* → Key Vault & Secrets; MessageBus.* → Communication & Messaging; Mail.* → Communication & Messaging; Monitoring.* / OpenTelemetry.* → Monitoring & Observability; UI.* → UI & Client Frameworks; AspNetCore.* → Web & API Development or Enterprise Features; CQRS / Core / Automations → Application Architecture; Financial/Geography/Mathematics/Physics/IO/Documents/Printer/Synchronization/Mvvm → Specialized Libraries. Only edit README.md if changes are actually needed. Do not commit.

A file that DEEPSEEK.md depends on was just changed. Read the changed file(s) and compare against DEEPSEEK.md to determine if it needs updating. DEEPSEEK.md is a flattened, self-contained version of CLAUDE.md + critical-rules.md + task-execution.md optimized for DeepSeek models (flatter structure, fewer cross-references, inline critical rules). Key rules for DEEPSEEK.md: (1) It must stay self-contained — inline the most important rules rather than referencing them. (2) It should be ~180-220 lines. (3) The subagent delegation table must match .ai/agents/. (4) The critical coding rules section must reflect the current critical-rules.md. (5) The task execution protocol must reflect task-execution.md. (6) It must remain a flat, direct instruction set — DeepSeek struggles with deeply nested cross-references. If DEEPSEEK.md is already accurate, do nothing. If changes are needed, edit it. Do NOT commit.

hooks.command: if ls *.sln *.slnx 2>/dev/null | grep -q .; then dotnet build --nologo --verbosity minimal; fi
